name: Quinoa Bowl with Roasted Carrots, Garlic-Lime Chickpeas & Cumin Yogurt

instructions.primary_message: Preheat the oven to 220°C (425°F) and place the rack in the center position. Line a large sheet pan with parchment paper (optional).
Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
12 medium carrots
1 ½ small bunches Italian (flat-leaf) parsley
3 limes

instructions.primary_message: Peel carrots, cut in half lengthwise, and add to the baking sheet.
Drizzle oil and honey over carrots and sprinkle with spices. Place carrots in the oven and cook, until tender, 15-20 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp honey
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
¾ tsp chili powder

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, shave the parsley leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Add to a large bowl (reserving some for garnish).
Peel and mince garlic. Zest the limes and add both to the bowl with the parsley. Add salt, pepper, and oil; stir to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
1 ½ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil

instructions.primary_message: Drain and rinse chickpeas. Add to the lime zest mixture​, along with the corn, and toss to coat. Spread out on another baking sheet and place in the oven with the carrots for the last 5 minutes of cooking.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (398 ml) cans garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
3 cups frozen corn

instructions.primary_message: Juice the limes into a medium bowl. Add yogurt, cumin, and salt; whisk to combine.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups plain Greek yogurt
1 tbsp cumin
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide quinoa between bowls, add roasted carrots, chickpeas, and corn. Drizzle with cumin yogurt and top with reserved parsley. Enjoy!
